name: pair-widget-pocs
description: Pair Widget PoCs — design dashboard backed by Redis, serving widget configs from Pair APIs or local overrides

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
